Sentence (English): I've used various Bosch full size dishwashers in my other apartments.
Comments (English): [ Great for small space, but 24 inch is much better ] || ---------------- || I've used various Bosch full size dishwashers in my other apartments. So when I needed to do a reno for a 1 bed apartment, I was definitely going to get a Bosch dishwasher. Unfortunately the ridiculously small kitchen could only fit an 18 inch dishwasher, so I got this model. It's quiet and has the features of a full size Bosch, so if you absolutely can't fit a full size, then this is a good alternative. The capacity feels a lot smaller than 67% of a normal dishwasher, all of the prongs and utensil basket look miniature, so you have to be more thoughtful about dish/utensils placement. I also feel like the amount of water left behind after a cycle is a bit more than a full size Bosch, so you need to leave the door open longer for air dry time. Really hard time fitting pots and pans like I do with my normal size Bosch, so I guess I'll be doing a lot more handwashing. I might remove the 3rd rack at the top since it makes the middle rack feel so tight - can't put a normal size water glass in the middle rack. Buy it if you don't have an alternative, but a full size Bosch 300 or 800 is soooo much better.

Sentence (English): A dishwasher is a dishwasher, right?
Comments (English): [ Superb. Worth every penny. ] || ---------------- || A dishwasher is a dishwasher, right? Not! We bought this Bosch 500 to replace an ageing GE Profile that was original to the house. We would only run that one at night because it was loud enough to run it while we were at the kitchen or watching tv in the den. We heard Bosch was great quality and we waited for a good sale. Reasons to buy: stainless steel interior (longevity) and 3 racks (top for utensils). But we were not ready for how freakishly quiet this thing is! You can be standing next to it and not know it's running. only the steady read light will tell you it's on. Super spacious and cleans dishes way better than our older one, granted that it was a generation or two older. Still, I can't imagine buying anything other than Bosch now.

The only point deducted is that it is promised that even plastic dishes will dry. However, she also has some problems with bowls, cups or cans. Jedoch bei Schüsseln, Becher oder Dosen hat auch sie etwas Probleme.Eigentlich gerne 5 Punkte aber oben genannter Mängel, gerne 4 1/2 Punkte aber nicht möglich zu wählen.

Sentence (English): I purchased this unit in April of 2023 and ever since I had it installed there has been an OC error if the dishwasher does not run at least every other day.
Comments (English): I purchased this unit in April of 2023 and ever since I had it installed there has been an OC error if the dishwasher does not run at least every other day. Took me a few weeks to really categorize the problem.If the dishwasher has a gap in running of 3 or more days, the OC error code is displayed. As soon as the unit is turned off and back on, it works perfectly fine.I had a technician from Home Service Network, Inc. come out and fix it by replacing the case break (plastic piece on the left side of the unit). He was rushed and did not take the time to understand the problem, left my kitchen a mess (water, towels, etc) and forced me to sign the service ticket without seeing a working dishwasher. I was told that there was water underneath the unit and it would dry up within 2 days and everything would be fine.A week later I was able to run the dishwasher but it had an LC error instead. Samsung sent out a technician from a different company and it turns out that the case break was installed incorrectly (hoses swapped) and the one hose leaks. The first technician broke the left door hinge. The case break has been swapped a second time and the unit still leaks. The unit is magically showing a FC error code after the 3rd attempt to fix it. Now the Samsung Technical Support is stating that the hoses and check valve have to be replaced. It's great to see that the Samsung Technical Support provides the technician photos of the hose that doesn't match the design of what the factory installed in the unit.With losing a half day every time that I have to wait for a technician to show up and a completely non-working dishwasher for the past several weeks, I would not recommend this unit to anyone.Not forgetting about the broken door, Samsung has told me that I have to contact Home Service Network, Inc. for them to replace the damage (they did such a horrible job that I will never use them again). It's great to see that their authorized repair centers are not capable of even returning a phone call after multiple voicemails have been left.

As soon as the unit is turned off and back on, it works perfectly fine.I had a technician from Home Service Network, Inc. come out and fix it by replacing the case break (plastic piece on the left side of the unit). He was rushed and did not take the time to understand the problem, left my kitchen a mess (water, towels, etc) and forced me to sign the service ticket without seeing a working dishwasher. I was told that there was water underneath the unit and it would dry up within 2 days and everything would be fine.A week later I was able to run the dishwasher but it had an LC error instead. Samsung sent out a technician from a different company and it turns out that the case break was installed incorrectly (hoses swapped) and the one hose leaks. The first technician broke the left door hinge. The case break has been swapped a second time and the unit still leaks. The unit is magically showing a FC error code after the 3rd attempt to fix it. Now the Samsung Technical Support is stating that the hoses and check valve have to be replaced. It's great to see that the Samsung Technical Support provides the technician photos of the hose that doesn't match the design of what the factory installed in the unit.With losing a half day every time that I have to wait for a technician to show up and a completely non-working dishwasher for the past several weeks, I would not recommend this unit to anyone.Not forgetting about the broken door, Samsung has told me that I have to contact Home Service Network, Inc. for them to replace the damage (they did such a horrible job that I will never use them again). It's great to see that their authorized repair centers are not capable of even returning a phone call after multiple voicemails have been left.

Sentence (English): When I received the dishwasher, the size exceeded expectations.
Comments (English): When I received the dishwasher, the size exceeded expectations. There were some small episodes during the installation process. The installer missed the time. If there is no major problem with the machine, I don’t care about it. It is bigger than expected, but I originally wanted to buy a bigger one. The maximum size of the small kitchen can only accommodate this size. I am quite satisfied with the capacity. Most of the time at home, two people eat, and one wash for two meals is enough. Picture 2 is put One pressure cooker, one milk pot, one frying pan, seven bowls plus one plate, milk pot lid, some chopsticks and spoons. The cleaning ability of the dishwasher is not bad, but it mainly depends on what kind of detergent is used. The one that comes with the machine is very bright. I have a small suggestion. Although the plastic basket for chopsticks and spoons in the dishwashing basket can be disassembled, it would be better if it can be designed around the four sides. It can put more tableware. Overall, I am satisfied.
Comments (Original): 收到洗碗机的时候大小是超过预期的，安装过程中出现一些小插曲，安装师傅误了时间，机器没有什么大问题就不计较这些了。比想象中大，不过原本也是想往大了买，小厨房最大尺寸也只能容纳这个大小，对于容量相当满意，家里大部分时间两个人吃饭，两顿洗一次完全够，图二是放了一个高压锅，一个奶锅，一个平底锅，七个碗加一个盘子还有奶锅锅盖，若干筷勺。洗碗机清洁能力还行，不过这个主要看放什么洗涤剂吧，随机器赠送的洗出来非常亮。有个小建议，洗碗篮中放筷勺的塑料篮虽然可以拆卸，但如果能设计在四边 周围的位置就更好了，能多放更多餐具整体来说满意

Sleek, clean.Cons: Maybe I missed this in the instructions but after the first wash, the unit stunk like rotting hot food. We ALWAYS clean all items before placing in unit, ALWAYS. We finally bought a dishwasher cleaner and ran per instructions. No more stink. Like I said, maybe I missed the instruction that said to run a dishwasher cleaner before your first wash. The wire used for the racks are spaced too far apart and if you're not careful, smallish things could easily fall through. The middle shelf is not deep enough for wine glasses or taller items. They could have given more space to the middle rack from the bottom rack. The cycle times are pretty long too. But, it does the job, and it's pretty quite. Had I first run a dishwasher cleaner I would not have had the stink problem and would have given this unit a 4-star rating, though I would still like more room on the middle shelf which is why I gave it a 3-star rating, but I would recommend.

Sentence (English): I first encountered a dishwasher 10 years ago when I was living in Canada.
Comments (English): [ Achieve your dream lifestyle! ] || ---------------- || I first encountered a dishwasher 10 years ago when I was living in Canada. Perhaps because I was so used to washing dishes, I insisted on using a dishwasher. A few years after returning to Korea, I noticed more and more households using dishwashers. With both spouses working, I couldn't help but neglect household chores. So, I started looking for a dishwasher. But they were incredibly expensive. Buying a product from a major domestic appliance company in the size I wanted would cost over 1 million won. Then, I found a Media dishwasher, a cost-effective option. It was a huge difference from the one I had 10 years ago. Here are my top picks! Cleaning power: You have to clean a dishwasher well first, right? I was skeptical because of the low price, but it cleans grease and sauces so well! I used to think I had to scrub it by hand to get it clean, but this one seems to be the perfect solution! Not only is this dishwasher large, but it also has wide trays on the top and bottom, allowing for a significant amount of storage. Auto door opening: I couldn't have imagined this feature in the dishwasher I had 10 years ago. In the past, water stains would remain because the dishwasher was still wet, but over time, dishwashers have improved significantly. After washing, the door automatically opens to cool and dry the dishwasher! It's a whole new world! The stainless steel interior feels luxurious, and the exterior has a consistent color scheme. The buttons and display are intuitive and nice. Various modes: I've only used the 90-minute mode and the glass-only mode, but there are seven modes, so you can customize them to your liking! In the past, I had to gather all the dishes before running the dishwasher, but this media dishwasher even has a 15-minute pre-rinse mode! This level of performance at this price point is incredible value. It feels like one appliance has improved my quality of life, and it's great that it's created conversation within the house. The dishwasher itself is large for 12 people, but these days, they say it's a big deal, and dishwashers are a big deal. Because it's bigger, it washes better, and the cleaning power seems to be correspondingly stronger, so I'm very satisfied. I hope this helps those considering buying it. ^^

Sentence (English): I first encountered a dishwasher 10 years ago when I was living in Canada.
Comments (English): [ Achieve your dream lifestyle! ] || ---------------- || I first encountered a dishwasher 10 years ago when I was living in Canada. Perhaps because I was so used to washing dishes, I insisted on using a dishwasher. A few years after returning to Korea, I noticed more and more households using dishwashers. With both spouses working, I couldn't help but neglect household chores. So I started looking for a dishwasher. But they were incredibly expensive. Buying a dishwasher from a major domestic appliance company in the size I wanted would cost over a million won. Then, I found a Media dishwasher, a cost-effective option. It was a huge difference from the dishwasher I had 10 years ago. Here are my top picks! Cleaning power. You have to clean a dishwasher well first, right? I was skeptical because of the low price, but it cleans grease and sauces so well! I used to think I had to scrub it by hand to keep it clean, but this one seems to be the perfect solution! Large capacity. Not only is the dishwasher large, but it also has wide trays on the top and bottom, allowing for a significant amount of storage. And the automatic door opening. This feature was unimaginable with the dishwasher I had 10 years ago. In the past, water stains would remain because the water would still drip down. But over time, dishwashers have improved significantly. After washing, the door automatically opens to cool and dry the dishes, making it a truly amazing experience! The design is stunning. The stainless steel interior is luxurious, and the exterior has a consistent color scheme. The buttons and display are intuitive and nice. The variety of modes is impressive. I've only used the 90-minute and glass-only modes, but there are seven different modes, so you can customize them to your liking! In the past, I'd have to gather all the dishes together before using the dishwasher, but this media dishwasher even has a 15-minute pre-rinse mode! This level of performance at this price point is incredible value. It feels like one appliance has improved my quality of life, and it's wonderful to see conversations taking place within the house. The appliance itself is large, designed for 12 people, but these days, dishwashers are truly a "bigger-than-bigger" machine. Because it's bigger, it washes better, and the cleaning power seems to match. I'm very satisfied. I hope this helps anyone considering buying one. ^^

Comments (English): [ Frustratingly Inefficient dishwasher on the basics ] || ---------------- || I recently purchased the Bosh 300 Series dishwasher with high hopes of a reliable and efficient cleaning solution for my kitchen. Unfortunately, my experience with this appliance has been nothing short of a nightmare. It's as if the engineers at Bosh thought that dishware comes in one standardized size, shape, and thickness, completely disregarding the reality of diverse kitchenware collections. This lack of flexibility is both infuriating and time-consuming, as I'm forced to spend extra minutes rearranging and reorganizing dishes before starting a cycle.Additionally, the tines themselves are poorly designed and spaced too closely together. This makes it challenging to secure plates and bowls in place.What adds to the disappointment is the fact that I purchased this dishwasher only a month ago, on June 1. I had high expectations for a reputable brand like Bosh, but this experience has left me disillusioned and regretful of my decision. I had hoped for a reliable appliance that would make my life easier, but instead, I've been left struggling with an inefficient, poorly designed machine.Given the persistent frustration I've faced with the Bosh 300 Series dishwasher, I cannot in good conscience recommend this appliance to anyone. The lack of adaptability in the rack design and the difficulty in finding an effective loading system have made it a complete waste of time and money. If you value efficiency and ease of use in your dishwasher, I suggest exploring alternative options that prioritize user experience and practicality.

Lesson learned, price does not equate to quality or durability. Buyer beware.

Sentence (English): We have been using this DW for a few weeks now.
Comments (English): [ It works about the same as the one it replaced ] || ---------------- || We have been using this DW for a few weeks now. Nothing special to the good or bad. It works about the same as the one it replaced. My problem with it has to do with the installation process. You see, you need two parts that are not included to do the installation. A hose fitting and a strain relief. But you don't know this because the instructions are inside the DW and the DW is inside the carton.So you get it in your kitchen, take off the carton, open the DW and find that the instructions will require a return trip to the store. See the picture showing the parts needed.To make it worst the strain relief needs to fit in a 7/8" (22 mm) hole. The assistant manager searched all over for something to fit a 7/8" hole. The best he could find had an OD of 6/8" (3/4") or 1/8" smaller. From looking at the fitting, we decided the flange around the fitting would be large enough to keep the fitting from slipping through a 7/8" hole.So home I go only to find out the 7/8" hole is not 7/8" but a lot smaller so the 3/4" fitting won't fit.At this point I am at the end of my rope. I had a cone shaped grinding wheel so I chucked it my drill motor and used it to make the hole large enough to take the fitting.See the picture of my grind stone after doing the job. It didn't have those groves in it before I started.

Sentence (English): Leaving aside the rest, I would like to thank Jingdong PLUS customer service first.
Comments (English): Leaving aside the rest, I would like to thank Jingdong PLUS customer service first. Under its coordination, the final installation is completed, although it is not perfect. Back to the product itself, the main problem this time is the installation. What I want to explain is that the installation process should be more professional, and the problem cannot always be guided to the customer. This time the installer came to the door twice in total. The connection speed of the machine is very fast. Because it is a wooden cabinet, holes were drilled at the beginning, and three wires such as the power cord, water inlet pipe, and drain pipe were passed. The hole was not drilled to the end or to the bottom. The machine might protrude a little, but I didn’t expect it to protrude more. In addition, the second time the master came and pulled the machine out, he saw that the drain pipe had been pressed out with deep lines, which may leak water. Finally wrapped in tinfoil. Then I went to install the door panel, because the master had never installed this door panel before, and after negotiation, I called the manufacturer's technical after-sales service and the door panel manufacturer, but neither of them could provide a solution on the phone at that time, and the meaning expressed was that it was a gift from JD.com. Not the original door panel from the manufacturer. I had no choice but to ask Jingdong customer service to intervene. Fortunately, the processing speed was relatively fast. The manufacturer also opened the phone and said that they would find a way to solve it, and sent a new order for the master to come again. After the second visit. I also invited the master who made the cabinet to come together, and then according to the condition of the cabinet, the hole was enlarged, and the pipe was passed through the vacant space on the back of the machine, and then the machine was pulled out to find that the pipe was pressed out with deep white marks , Later I thought that this problem should actually be avoided. Finally, the door panel was installed, but there was a large seam, which was not perfect.
Comments (Original): 其它先不说，先感谢下京东PLUS客服，在其协调下，最终安装完成，虽然不是很完美。回到产品本身，这次主要的问题集中在安装上面，想说明的是就是安装过程感觉应该更专业一些，不能总把问题向客户身上引导。本次安装师傅总共上门两次，机器连接速度很快，因为是木质柜体，所以一开始打了孔，传了电源线、进水管、排水管等三根线，一开始也简单说了因为开孔没有开到最后和开到底，机器可能会突出一点，但是没想到突出比较多，另外从第二次师傅过来把机器拉出看排水管已经被压出很深的纹，都有可能漏水，最后用锡箔纸裹了下。然后就到门板安装，因为师傅之前没有安装过这个门板，经协商就打电话咨询厂家技术售后和门板厂家，但是二者当时电话里均不能提供解决方案，而且表达的意思是属于京东活动赠送，并不是厂家的原装门板。我没有办法就请京东客服介入了，还好处理速度较快，厂家也打开电话，说会想办法解决，也重新派单让师傅重新上门。第二次上门后。我也请做柜子的师傅一起来了，然后根据柜体情况，把孔加大，在机器背部空出地方将管子穿出，然后将机器来拉出来就发现管子被压出很深的白痕，后来就想这个问题其实应该可以避免。最后门板装上了，但是留了很大缝，不完美。

Sentence (English): Midea's 16 sets of built-in dishwashers GX1000S are generally well received after 8 days of use.
Comments (English): Midea's 16 sets of built-in dishwashers GX1000S are generally well received after 8 days of use. 1. Three-layer bowl basket. Before buying, I paid special attention to the dishwasher with three-layer flat bowl basket. COLMO Midea's offline products also have other styles, so I chose this one. 2. Self-contained and dual-purpose. I care more about the quality of the home appliances. The decoration is for the normal use of the home appliances and easy maintenance. It doesn't matter if it looks good or not. Kitchen decoration is often expensive because of the expensive cabinets. If the Chinese style chops meat constantly, one of the reasons for the cost is that the cabinets where the chopping is done must be firm. The free-standing dishwasher can be placed directly after the things are placed on it, and it can be directly used as a countertop, and there is no need for cabinets that can be cut. 3. Place the dishes Every dishwasher has to adapt. Putting the same tableware and the same oil stains in different places is the process of experimentation. 4. According to the introduction, standard washing within 2 hours is the most commonly used. 5. The master comes to install it without leaking once. 6. I cleaned the stainless steel oil screen with ultra-clean, and I am satisfied with it overall. Please refer to the photo for details after washing.

Sentence (English): Our previous dishwasher made it through lots of kids and parties but gave up the ghost a couple of months ago.
Comments (English): [ THIS WILL MAKE YOU LOVE TO DO THE DISHES!  ] || ---------------- || Our previous dishwasher made it through lots of kids and parties but gave up the ghost a couple of months ago. My American Idol watching buddy and I were, you guessed it, watching American Idol, when we heard a pop or two and found smoke coming out of our dishwasher. We liked the kitchen aid brand and found this upscale version that had a third rack for the extras you never know where to put. This top third row isn't just flat. It has a right side that is flat for those kinds of tools. The left side has some depth so you can place small bowls, measuring ups and labels or whatever you like. The machine is fairly quiet. I'm loving the smudge free stainless steel exterior. All in all we're pleased with the new appliance. We did have issues with the delivery. We waited 2 weeks for the delivery and got dishwasher hands. When the installer came with the dishwasher Kitchen-aid had neglected to put in a drainage tube which caused much difficulty getting the simple part. We finally had to cancel that dishwasher and order the same one with the drainage hose. Our installer said it was the second kitchen-aid that he tried to install that week that was missing the hose.

Installation was pretty easy--we did not want nor need to pay someone half the price of the appliance to install it. A few videos later it was installed and running. Dishes, pans glasses, flatware--all come out sparkling. We use a rinse aid so all the hard surface items dry completely. Plastics etc do retain moisture--for us that is inconsequential--why others complain about this is a mystery. Bosch quality and reliability are cited in countless professional reviews--we are confident that our decision was a wise one--so far, so really good!

Comments (English): [ Great dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || Took some time to get used to, but now I love it! All the prongs are slanted, and my other dishwasher they were straight up. I love the dry feature that opens the door at the end of the cycle! I run mine during the night and when I wake up, it's ready to unload and with the door open the dishes are cool and dry. Of course, I love the convenient third shelf. I had one in my old dishwasher so was familiar with it--it's great for lids, utensils, anything small and kinda flat. I really wanted the black stainless, but wasn't available. The stainless is good too--just have to clean fingerprints off more often. Glad we bought this dishwasher!

Sentence (English): I have been hand washing for two years since my old DW broke.
Comments (English): [ Don't wait…. buy it now! ] || ---------------- || I have been hand washing for two years since my old DW broke. During that time I've been researching and waiting for the right deal to appear. I finally pulled the plug and purchased the 800 series and I couldn't be any happier. The installation was simple and very explanatory with the included manual. Visit their website and you'll be inundated with "How To" videos for most of you're questions answered with a visual explanations. I had no issues and was done in less than an hour. The directions for walking you through the different cycles and options seems overwhelming at first but I used every setting and now have a complete understanding of what they provide to the cleaning process. There are many and you'll probably have a couple of favorites that will be used most. I like the option of having more for those special occasions that require something different than normal. At first I didn't think I turned the DW on and checked it twice to make sure. The floor light was on and I still couldn't believe it until I heard the water being drained. It is the quietest by far. Loading is a breeze and offer so many options. that was the issue. I tried to fill the DW with as may dishes I could to test its ability to clean and dry. The options of rack tines lowering or upright seems redundant with the fixed tines but to my surprise they are useful and engineered to last. The racks are smooth and offer the option of lowering or raising the middle rack for larger utensils on the lower rack. With this in mind if you place the middle rack at an angle to let water run off those pesky mugs that have a water holding crater on the bottom that never dries. now they will! Speaking of drying, no need for a towel to dry those mugs prior to clearing the DW. Oh ya, have you ever had one of those people tell you that putting plastic containers in a DW is releasing caustic chemicals? Well no worries with Crystal Dry. It has performed as advertised and No Heating Element on the bottom to assist in drying, for me this is the most important option. Living in Hawaii where electricity and water are the most expensive consumables used daily. When asked how it works by friends I first reply with two words "Science & Engineering". You'll find no other DW that comes close. What would I add or change if I were a design engineer for Bosch? The visual light indicator should beam the light with the words "running and done" or like another model showing the time remaining till done washing on the floor. That's it! Bottom line for me. I never thought id tell someone that I fell in love with a DW. I couldn't be more pleased, happy, satisfied. The wait was worth it.

The visual light indicator should beam the light with the words 'running and done' or like another model showing the time remaining till done washing on the floor.  That's it! Bottom line for me...I never thought id tell someone that I fell in love with a DW. I couldn't be more pleased, happy, satisfied. The wait was worth it.

Sentence (English): I'm a homebody who enjoys cooking at home.
Comments (English): [ I recommend it for its clean design and satisfactory performance! ] || ---------------- || I'm a homebody who enjoys cooking at home. Washing dishes takes longer than cooking, so I decided to escape dishwashing hell and buy a dishwasher! Before purchasing, I researched and compared various brands, features, prices, and things to consider when buying a dishwasher. I first saw Media Brand on Coupang, so I searched extensively. It was a larger Chinese brand than I expected, and it also provides OEM services to various companies. I assumed other companies would have done a lot of the research for me, so I decided to buy. ^^ One important thing to consider was after-sales service. Electricity and water bills were so low (it's said you save water compared to hand washing), they weren't a major concern. It's very easy to use. The tray is large enough to fit most frying pans and pots, and the included cutlery holder makes it easy to wash separately. The default operating time is 90 minutes, but you can set the timer (there are various cycles, including Strong, Normal, Eco, Glass, Rapid, and Pre-wash). With just a few presses of a button, it's done. I thought a lot about buying it sooner. The interior is all stainless steel, so it's clean. It's much more durable than plastic. I also liked the automatic door opening function. Since the dishes are washed in hot water, they dry really well just by opening the door. The reason I chose the media brand is because the price is great. The functions are not much different from those of major brands, but I was really surprised that it's less than half the price. It washes well, so it's really cost-effective. One thing to keep in mind is that dried food must be soaked in water before putting it in. Otherwise, it won't be cleaned cleanly and some will remain. I soak it in water, collect it in the evening, and use it all at once. Please keep this in mind when purchasing~!

Sentence (English): I'm a homebody who enjoys cooking at home.
Comments (English): [ I recommend it for its clean design and satisfactory performance! ] || ---------------- || I'm a homebody who enjoys cooking at home. Since I spend more time washing dishes than cooking, I decided to escape dishwashing hell and buy a dishwasher! Before purchasing, I researched and compared various brands, features, prices, and things to consider when buying a dishwasher. I first saw Media Brand on Coupang, so I searched extensively. It turned out to be a larger Chinese brand than I expected, and I also spoke to several other companies. It was an OEM company. I assumed other companies would have done a lot of the research for me, so I decided to buy it. ^^. One important factor I considered was after-sales service. The electricity and water bills were so low (it's actually said to save water compared to hand washing). It wasn't a major consideration. It's very easy to use. The tray is large enough to hold most frying pans and pots. I also liked the separate cutlery holder, which allows for separate dishwashing. The default operating time is 90 minutes, but you can set a timer (there are various cycles, including Strong, Standard, Eco, Glass, Rapid, and Pre-wash). It's a whole new world where you just press a few buttons and it's done. I really wish I had bought it sooner. The interior is all stainless steel, so it's clean and tidy. It's also much more durable than plastic. I also like the automatic door-opening feature. The dishes are washed in hot water, so just leaving the door open dries them really well. I chose the media brand because of the incredible price. The features aren't much different from those of major brands, but I was surprised that it costs less than half. It washes well, too, so it's a great value. One thing to keep in mind: Dried food must be soaked in water before use. Otherwise, it won't be cleaned cleanly and will remain. I soak them in water, then collect them in the evening and use them all at once. Keep this in mind when purchasing!

Sentence (English): I'm sure this isn't a Bosch problem.
Comments (English): [ Delivered defective product ] || ---------------- || I'm sure this isn't a Bosch problem. We have had Bosch dishwashers for over 20 years. They are well designed, well engineered and have been relatively trouble free for us. So when our current dishwasher went out a week ago I went back and forth on whether to troubleshoot/repair of get a new one (current one was 12 years old) and bought from Lowe's. We found this model with the stainless tub and third rack. Placed the order online and it was delivered on Friday. I installed on Saturday morning and got ready to test before pushing back under the cabinet…only to find the third silverware rack was off the rails and one of the glider wheels in the bottom of the tub. No problem. Pull the third rack out, grab the glider wheel and see that its mounting place had busted. Ok not a deal breaker. Wheel goes in and the rack still works. Try to shut the door to test operate but the door wouldn't shut. Maybe a rack wasn't all the way in? Turns out the door doesn't shut because the inner stainless tub has been bent (pic 1) and the door won't seal. Try to open the door all the way and it jams up. One of the door guides is bent. Upon further inspection the tub appears to be bowed on one side. Now I'm beginning to wonder what these marks are on the side (pic 2). There is no way this product should have ever made it out of the warehouse. So I call Lowe's to request a return/exchange. Amber listens to my explanation and dutifully makes notes and tells me that a rep from my new nearest Lowe's will call me back in 24 hours. What will they do? I need this thing exchanged. Amber says that the rep has to talk to me before they decide to take any action. “What do yo mean? ” I asked. Lowe's has my money and yet they delivered a defective product and I have to let them keep my money while they decide what to do? I want a working dishwasher. Amber insists that this is the protocol and she can't request any other level of service. I ask if I can go to my Lowe's store (4-5) miles away and speak to a manager there? No she tells me. In fact because I ordered it online the store manager can't help me. Someone from the fulfillment center will have to contact me. The fulfillment center is something like 60 miles away. When will they call? I ask. Amber says they are supposed to call in 24 hours. Since this is Saturday I ask Amber will they call on Sunday. Amber simply says that they are supposed to call in 24 hours. So here I sit, two days before the 4th of July…waiting on Lowes to somehow “right” this. Maybe they will come through. It's been over 24 hours….to be continued.

I think I'm on the fence because of the fact that the cups sometimes are still a little wet on the base sometimes where water accumulated. I think that it has to do with the fact that those times, the rinse aid has run out. Other than that, this thing is amazing and I don't expect to buy another dishwasher for a long, long time.

Sentence (English): This is our 2nd Kitchenaid dishwasher, after our 1st unit finally started to wear out - following 16+ years of flawless service.
Comments (English): [ Decent mid-priced Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This is our 2nd Kitchenaid dishwasher, after our 1st unit finally started to wear out - following 16+ years of flawless service. After 3 weeks of use, our new Kitchenaid dishwasher has been working as well as can be expected. Our only complaint is related to how the water supply line is connected to the dishwasher. The threaded connection on the dishwasher is plastic and it can be tricky to ensure that the 90 deg. copper elbow fitting (not included) is properly threaded (i.e. avoiding cross-threading). As well the insulation on the exterior of the dishwasher was not as firmly attached as I would have liked. I had to be very careful sliding the unit into it the opening below our counter, in order to avoid having the insulation pull away from the unit.

Comments (English): [ I am very satisfied with the cost-effective dishwasher from Media! ] || ---------------- || As my child grows, I realized I absolutely needed a dishwasher to handle the increasing amount of dishes, so I purchased one. I was planning on a 6-seater, but I ended up buying a 12-seater. This was my first time experiencing on-site installation, and the delivery person from the partner company was very considerate of the space and did a very thorough job. I was surprised to see all the smart features, like automatic moisture drainage and anti-backwashing, included in a product of this price range. I highly recommend this dishwasher for its great value and large capacity. :) Having a dishwasher is so convenient and my back doesn't hurt! It's changed my quality of life.

Sentence (English): The dishwasher has been fantastic so far.
Comments (English): [ Great Dishwasher, Documentation could be better ] || ---------------- || The dishwasher has been fantastic so far. I especially love the third rack for small items. However, the instruction manual could use some work, as it does not document what kind of threads are on the inlet connection. Ultimately, I was able to identify the threads (a type of straight pipe thread that is uncommon/nonexistent in the US) by comparing the included adapter to parts the hardware store, but that is information that should definitely be included in the installation document. Other notes: I don't have hard water, but I suspect the built in water softener makes a big difference for people that do. Although I originally did not like the idea of a Wi-Fi connected appliance, I can see how it opens up opportunities for improved user experience. However, I don't think it's being used to its full potential, yet. First, I would prefer to see the appliance connect through Bluetooth OR WiFi, so that I do not have to have the security risk it could theoretically pose by being connected to the network. Second, I don't know if Bosch intends to release software updates via the Wi-Fi connection, but that is an area that they may be able to take advantage of to improve their appliance even after purchase (assuming they can identify a change they can be applied through software only). Third, in addition to maintenance reminders like refilling rinse aid and salt, the app could provide diagnostic information in the case of appliance failures.

Sentence (English): First of all, I decided to buy this M10 after reading Youtun’s evaluation.
Comments (English): First of all, I decided to buy this M10 after reading Youtun’s evaluation. The reasons are as follows: 1. Desktop, no installation, no tee connection, manual water addition is an advantage for me, 5L can be filled up. 2. According to some evaluation results, M10 has a relatively large advantage in saving water and electricity. It also has ultra-fast washing within 30 minutes and standard washing in 1 hour and 20 minutes, which has advantages over other brands. 3. Small and exquisite. Although not too much, it is enough for a small family. Second, so far, washed 3 times. For the first time, I used a super fast wash after opening the box, mainly to test the machine. Although there are few bowls, the washing is still slightly flawed, and I can only give 80 points, but the glass pot lid is very clean. The second time, I used the standard washing method, and the porridge spoon on the upper layer still had sticky matter. The overall score was 85, which was better than the first time. It may be due to the long washing time and the high water temperature. The third time, I still used standard washing, put the dishwasher in the expected position, and then bought an extension tube on the next platform, put it on directly, and the washing effect was satisfactory, and I gave it 90 points. Let me talk about the disadvantages: 1. Since there is no drying function, I asked the customer service and said that this product is stored in cold air and antibacterial. After washing, the machine is wet. In order to save time and electricity costs, I took out the dishes and turned off the power. , Let the machine ventilate and dry itself, which is better. 2. The original drainage pipe is a bit short, and the manufacturability is poor. Summary: It is still recommended to use standard washing, so that it will be clean and worry-free. I hope these experiences can bring some help to the latecomers. The consumable dishwashing beads are free, no matter how many bowls there are or how many bowls there are, if you use one grain at a time, no evaluation will be made. Overall satisfied.
Comments (Original): 首先，看了有调测评后决定买这款M10，原因有以下几点：1、台式，免安装，免接三通，手动加水对我来说是优势，5L加满即可。2、根据有点测评结果来看，M10优势比较大，省水省电，也有超快速洗30分钟内，标准洗1小时20分，比其他品牌有优势。3、小巧。虽然装不太多，但足够小家庭使用。其次，到目前为止，洗了3次。第一次，是开箱后用超快速洗，主要是测试机器。虽然碗少，但洗还是略有瑕疵，只能给80分，但玻璃锅盖洗得挺干净。第二次，用标准洗，还是放在上层的粥勺有黏物，总体评分85，比第一次好，可能是洗的时间久和水温高有关系。第三次，还是用标准洗，把洗碗机放在预想的位置，然后在隔壁平台买了延长管，直接套上，洗碗效果满意，给90分。说下缺点：1、由于没有烘干功能，问了客服说这款是冷风抑菌保存，洗好后机器里湿湿的，为了节省时间和电费，就把碗筷拿出来，把电源关掉，让机器自己通风吹干，得这样比较好。2、原装的排水管有点短，可造性较差。总结：还是建议用标准洗，这样洗得干净，也比较省心。希望这些经验能给后来者带来一些帮助。耗材洗碗凝珠是送的，不管碗多碗少，洗一次用一粒，就不做评价。总体满意。

I manually open the door to let the steam escape. Maybe I don't have that model? We have other LG appliances and I trust the brand. But it's too hard to drive the dishwasher, and I'm a technically competent person.

Sentence (English): I have had the dishwasher for 2 weeks and used the prowash and prodry settings.
Comments (English): [ Kinda perfect! ] || ---------------- || I have had the dishwasher for 2 weeks and used the prowash and prodry settings. I have also used the top 2 racks setting on a couple of loads. Each time all of my dishes have come out clean and dry. I have now emptied it several times and the majority of those times I don't have to dry off anything at all, I just put it away. 2 times I have had a small plastic medicine cup flip over and hold water, and one plastic storage lid placed flat in the top rack held a little water. I haven't used more than 3 paper towels all together when putting away my dishes since I got this dishwasher, and I am pretty happy about that! I don't cook every day, and being able to put utensils, cups, bowls, and full sized plates on just the top 2 racks allows me to keep things washed up without waiting for a full load. I lay my utensils flat on the basket on the very top rack rather than using the large basket on the bottom rack when I use that option. It will not hold a lot of forks or spoons that way, but it is fine for my family of 4. I do pre-rinse most of my dishes, but I've put in a few things unrinsed and there hasn't been a problem so far. This is a quiet dishwasher, but it is not quite as quiet as the whirlpool dishwasher it is replacing. That's not an issue for me, but for some that might be. In my many years of dishwashing, this dishwasher has made the most difference in the time it takes me to do dishes by hand versus using the dishwasher. I am very happy with it! Now if it will just work for a good, long, time!
